cover_illustration.alt_text: Watercolor and ink cover illustration for Beyond the Waterfall, Book 1: The Three Paths. Eleven-year-old Clara with straight light-brown hair, bangs, and a slate-blue cloak holds swirling violet-gold sparks beside Maya in her mustard bandana with turquoise frog Pebble and Sam in crooked glasses holding his star-diagram notebook, gazing out from a waterfall arch toward Glassvale Academy's Brass Spire, Bell-Tower, Living Dome, and floating-crown Starlight Tower under a wide twilight sky.
